title: Recording with Tiny Parham
summary: He confirms the Parham records came in the twenties, before Hines.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: That's really young. You recorded with -- to go back to Tiny Parham, you recorded with him. Do you remember when -- was that in the thirties, or --
Yeah, I think that was in -- let's see, now, that was -- had to be before -- couldn't have been the thirties, because it was before Earl Hines days.
Have to be the twenties, then.
Did Parham sing? Or do I have him mixed up with another piano player who sang?
